recovery_position: Resolve review_snapshot_commit from the canonical program, enumerate git rev-list <baseline_commit>..<review_snapshot_commit>, and revert every returned commit newest-to-oldest as one bounded operation.
limitations: Execute in a clean disposable checkout and preserve the candidate reference before recovery.
The range must be linear; merge commits fail certification until explicit mainline handling is supported.
Rollback restores repository state only; it does not retract already distributed reports or external copies.
The doctor and comparative validator perform bounded static checks and do not certify providers, deployments, or SEO outcomes.
PROVIDER, DEPLOYED, and OPERATIONAL evidence remain out of scope.
